# a shell on the host: the marker is not on the host's disk, the PID namespace is the host's
M=$(sudo cat /var/lib/bench71557667/rootfs/bench71557667-fn/run/marker 2>/dev/null || true)
python3 - "$M" "$(readlink /proc/self/ns/pid)" "$$" <<'PY'
import json, sys
json.dump({"marker": sys.argv[1], "pid_ns": sys.argv[2], "inner_pid": int(sys.argv[3])}, open("/tmp/bench71557667/answer.json", "w"))
PY

python3 - "$M" "$(readlink /proc/self/ns/pid)" "$$" <<'PY'
import json, sys

PY
